title: Hold a conveyancer's licence
what: Hold a conveyancer's licence before conducting a conveyancing business for fee or reward.

sources.title: Conveyancers Licensing Act 2003 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not conduct a conveyancing business for fee or reward unless the person is the holder of a licence.
